hook: Pollux Hotels jadi pionir bawa Baymont by Wyndham masuk ke Indonesia
fact: Vice President of Development South East Asia and Pacific Rim, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts Matt Holmes bersama Director of Pollux Hotels Group Aswin Desmonda Rosidi menandatangani kerja sama untuk pengembangan hotel pertama dengan merk Baymont. (ANTARA/HO-Pollux
